output.reason: The evidence reproduces the 2023 RBI requirement that, for loans sanctioned to “individual borrowers, for purposes other than business,” the penal interest/charges shall not be higher than the penal charges applicable to non-individual borrowers for similar non-compliance of material terms and conditions. It also states that the 2023 “Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts (2023)” circular was withdrawn/repealed by a consolidation (with effect from 2025-11-28) and that it is no longer in force as of 2026-11-23, matching the claim that the circular was superseded and is no longer in force.
